findings.description: The change drops extract_zipped_paths for the default CA bundle path. If requests runs from a zipped package (zipapp/zipimport) and certs.where() returns a path inside the archive, the file is no longer extracted.
findings.rationale: Trigger: requests is loaded from a zip and verify is True, so cert_loc falls back to DEFAULT_CA_BUNDLE_PATH. The path points inside the zip, so os.path.exists fails and an OSError is raised for the missing CA bundle. Every HTTPS request then fails. This only holds if certs.where() can return a zip-internal path, which the added comment ("extracted by certifi") suggests is no longer guaranteed.
